title: A familiar voice asks for emergency money
mechanism_summary: A consumer advisory describes scammers cloning a relative's voice to claim an emergency. The familiar sound is used to persuade the recipient to send money.
suggested_beats: A call sounds like a loved one.
An urgent payment is requested.
Call the loved one through a known number.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone concerned for a family member
why_it_works: Recognition can make an unverified emergency feel certain.

title: A director's cloned voice authorizes a transfer
mechanism_summary: A reported investigation describes a bank employee receiving what sounded like a familiar company director's call. A fabricated acquisition story and supporting emails persuaded the employee to authorize transfers.
suggested_beats: A familiar business voice calls.
An acquisition requires urgent transfers.
Verify payment instructions through established channels.
why_it_works: A familiar voice and consistent paperwork reinforce each other.

title: An official-sounding voice requests private documents
mechanism_summary: An official warning describes AI voice messages impersonating senior officials. The campaign moves contacts into private messaging and solicits sensitive documents.
suggested_beats: An apparent official initiates contact.
Private documents are requested.
Verify the request through an independently sourced office contact.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone approached by an apparent senior official
why_it_works: Authority and personal attention can lower resistance to disclosure.

title: A cloned official voice requests a linking code
mechanism_summary: An advisory describes an official-impersonation campaign using AI voice messages. Requests for authentication codes can give attackers access to the target's contact list.
suggested_beats: An apparent official establishes rapport.
A linking code is requested.
Never pass authentication codes to an unverified contact.
why_it_works: A trusted persona disguises a request that enables further targeting.

title: A job interview conceals a different speaker
mechanism_summary: An advisory reports suspected voice spoofing or voice deepfakes during remote job interviews. Mismatched sound and visible actions helped reveal deception about the applicant.
suggested_beats: A remote applicant joins an interview.
Audio and visible actions do not align.
Verify applicant identity through independent checks.
why_it_works: A mediated interview can obscure who is actually speaking.

title: A political robocall borrows a leader's voice
mechanism_summary: An enforcement announcement describes fraudulent election robocalls using a cloned political leader's voice. The audio made deceptive outreach appear to come from that leader.
suggested_beats: A voter receives a political call.
A familiar voice lends authority to the message.
Verify election information through official channels.
why_it_works: A recognizable voice can lend credibility to deceptive political messaging.

title: A child's apparent voice supports a kidnapping hoax
mechanism_summary: Police reporting describes a parent receiving a fake kidnapping call using what sounded like their child's voice. The apparent distress was used to make an invented abduction believable.
suggested_beats: A parent hears an apparent child in distress.
A caller claims a kidnapping.
Contact the child independently and seek police help.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: a parent alarmed by a distress call
why_it_works: A familiar distressed voice can overwhelm the opportunity to verify.

title: A cloned customer voice targets a financial account
mechanism_summary: An advisory identifies AI-generated audio used to impersonate account holders. Criminals use the false voice to try to obtain financial-account access.
suggested_beats: A caller sounds like the account holder.
The caller seeks account access.
Use verification beyond voice recognition.
why_it_works: A voice match can create false confidence in identity.
